title.id: Undang-Undang mengalokasikan 30.000 dolar AS dari Dana Standar Emas untuk membayar bunga sertifikat utang yang diterbitkan pemerintah Kepulauan Filipina berdasarkan undang-undang Kongres tanggal 2 Maret 1903

text.en:
There is hereby appropriated, out of the gold-standard fund, the sum of thirty thousand dollars,
money of the United States, for the payment of quarterly interest due December first, nineteen hundred and
four, on the certificates of indebtedness amounting to three million dollars, issued and sold on behalf of the
Insular Government by the Secretary of War under authority of the Act of Congress approved March second,
nineteen hundred and three, and Act Numbered Eleven hundred and ninety-five of the Philippine
Commission.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in 'the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, November 14, 1904.
